payload.title: A tank can live in both the equipment and tanks tables under one id, and farm writes the tanks row first but reads the equipment row first, so a re-homed tank is refused at its new department and a deleted one stays placeable
evidence: apps/farm-service/src/equipment/handlers/update-equipment.handler.ts:59-65 (tanks row first, only that row updated)
apps/farm-service/src/batch/utils/tank-lookup.util.ts:160-193 (resolveUnitSiteIds DISTINCT ON unitId across both tables, no liveness)
payload.rule_violated: Single owner per concept: one live row answers for a farm unit; reads and writes agree on it
payload.notes: Latent on 2026-10-30: the production tenant's 16 tanks are all in tanks only, no id in both tables (read-only count).
